enums.name: ke_result_domain
enums.doc: The domains that own a range of result codes. A domain's own codes are written `KE_RESULT_CODE(KE_RESULT_DOMAIN_ <DOMAIN >, n)` in its header, with `n` from 1 up.

enums.name: ke_result
enums.doc: What a fallible call returns: `KE_OK`, or the code of the failure. The detail of a failure goes to the failing library's log, never into the code. A caller treats a code it does not know as `KE_RESULT_GENERAL`. Ignoring the result of a call is a compiler warning where the compiler supports it.

enums.name: ke_scheduler_cadence
enums.doc: When an executable runs within the ticks of a scheduler.

values.name: KE_SCHEDULER_CADENCE_EVERY_TICK
values.doc: Once per tick, with the tick's dt.

values.name: KE_SCHEDULER_CADENCE_FIXED
values.doc: Once per fixed step, as many steps as the tick's time covers, with the fixed dt. Fixed executables added one after another run together, in order, at each step.

values.name: KE_SCHEDULER_CADENCE_STARTUP
values.doc: Once, before every other executable of the first tick, with a dt of zero.

values.name: KE_SCHEDULER_CADENCE_SHUTDOWN
values.doc: Once, when the scheduler shuts down after a tick ran, with a dt of zero.

structs.name: ke_scheduler_config
structs.doc: What a scheduler is created with, each field applied as given.

fields.name: fixed_dt
fields.doc: The dt of a fixed step, in seconds; greater than zero.

fields.name: fixed_dt_max_accum
fields.doc: The most time a tick may accumulate for fixed steps, in seconds; the excess is dropped; greater than zero.

vtables.name: ke_scheduler
vtables.doc: The frame loop: runs the executables it was given, each when its cadence says, tick by tick, waiting on each run before the next starts. It knows no schedule, render, event or component.

slots.name: add
slots.doc: Adds an executable; a tick runs the executables in the order they were added.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null run or an unknown cadence; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED after shutdown; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: run
params.doc: Starts one run of the executable.

params.name: user
params.doc: Forwarded to run, and the name completed_since knows the executable by.

slots.name: tick
slots.doc: Drains the job and async systems, then runs the executables: on the first tick the startup ones first, then each every-tick one, and each block of fixed ones once per fixed step the accumulated time covers, the accumulation capped at fixed_dt_max_accum.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a negative dt; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED after shutdown; the code a run failed with, no later executable running.

slots.name: shutdown
slots.doc: Runs the shutdown executables once if a tick ran; a later call does nothing, and a later tick is refused. Destroying the scheduler calls it for a caller that did not.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; the code a run failed with.

slots.name: request_exit
slots.doc: Records that the program should end; any body or the caller may ask, from any thread.

slots.name: exit_requested
slots.doc: Whether a request to end the program was recorded.

slots.name: sequence
slots.doc: The number of the run started last; every run started takes the next number, and zero means none started. Readable from any thread; a body stamps what it writes with it.

slots.name: completed_since
slots.doc: Whether every executable added with user completed a run numbered sequence or later; true when none was added with it. Called from a body or between ticks.

slots.name: fixed_alpha
slots.doc: How far the time accumulated toward the next fixed step is, in [0, 1): what the tick's fixed steps left over divided by fixed_dt. Read between ticks or from a body.

functions.name: ke_scheduler_create
functions.doc: Creates a scheduler with no executable, which drains job_system and async, both borrowed for its lifetime, at the start of every tick.
functions.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null job_system, async, config or out_scheduler, or a fixed_dt or fixed_dt_max_accum not greater than zero; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: config
params.doc: Required; every field is read as given.

params.name: out_scheduler
params.doc: Receives the scheduler; left zeroed on failure.

callbacks.name: ke_scheduler_run_fn
callbacks.doc: One run of an executable: a schedule, a render, a script, a test.

lanes.name: out_completion
lanes.doc: Receives the run's completion, which the scheduler waits on and releases.

callbacks.name: ke_async_fn
callbacks.doc: The body of an operation, run once on a worker that may block in a system call.

callbacks.name: ke_job_fn
callbacks.doc: The body of a job, run once on a worker after every dependency finished, whatever each finished with.

callbacks.name: ke_job_range_fn
callbacks.doc: One range of a parallel_for, run on a worker; ranges cover [0, item_count) without overlap.

lanes.name: worker_index
lanes.doc: Unique among the threads running at once, in [0, worker_slots).
